content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A necessity appeal has already been filed, while resubmission, another appeal without a current denial, or billing the patient would not comply with the available facts and payer rules. With no valid automated payer action remaining and only 15 days left in the 120-day collection window, specialist escalation is the only action that can properly investigate and progress the balance."}
